connector.name: Mathlas
connector.registryDescription: Airtight math for AI agents: 3.68M-doc theorem search + numeric/Lean verification. No LLM, no key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mathlas-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the archerkattri account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MATHLAS_SEED
env.description: Set to 1 to force the lightweight built-in seed corpus and never load the multi-GB prebuilt index (fast cold start).

env.name: MATHLAS_INDEX
env.description: Path to a prebuilt index .npz to serve for search_existing_math (optional; the seed corpus is used when absent).
